ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-05-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/Gina Gonzales, CSR: Loretta Najera.
Petitioner: Xiao Zhu, present, as guardian ad litem for Minors: Li Shan Liu and Li Ping Liu, and with Cantonese Interpreter: William Guan, were sworn and examined.
Petitioner: Huo Dai Liu, minors' father, was not present, but signed the petition.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the Petition for Change of Name of Minor to: Brianna Liu.
The Court grants the Petition for Change of Name of Minor to: Joyce Liu.
Decree signed in open court.
